gates.name: MCP files hold the SonarQube token and organization as placeholders, never as values
gates.checks: It reads `.mcp.json`, `.github/mcp.json` and `.vscode/mcp.json`, and fails when the `sonarqube` server sends a token value, an organization value or another variable name. It skips files that git ignores. Exit 2 means a file cannot be read or parsed, and exit 3 means there is no MCP file.
gates.fix: Replace the value with `${AISDLC_SONAR_MCP_TOKEN}` or `${AISDLC_SONAR_ORG}`, and replace a token that was committed.
